intro.heading: Getting Started
intro.subheading1: Our app allows you to keep track of expenses without having to manually update them!
intro.subheading2: To do this we require you to do 2 things:
steps: Set up email transaction alerts from your own bank.
Set up auto forwarding from your email to your unique forwarding email that we assign you.

emailAlerts.heading: Email Transaction Alerts
emailAlerts.description: Most banks provide email transaction alerts for transactions over a certain limit (e.g. $200).

steps.text: Find out how to change the transaction alert limit.
Change the transaction alert limit to $0. This ensures you receive an email for every transaction.
Ensure the email that receives alerts is the same email you use to sign in to our app.

notes: Since the transaction limit is set to $0, you may receive a large volume of emails.
We recommend creating a rule to move transaction alert emails into a separate folder.
After setting up forwarding and filters, you may choose 'Archive Gmail’s copy' or 'Delete Gmail’s copy' (not recommended).

sections.heading: Get your Unique Forwarding Email Address
steps: Sign into our app using the Sign in With Google button.
Go to Settings → Your unique forwarding address and copy the address.

sections.heading: Open Gmail Settings
steps: Open Gmail settings and click 'See all settings'.

sections.heading: Add your forwarding email
steps: Go to the 'Forwarding and POP/IMAP' tab.
Click 'Add a forwarding address' and paste your unique forwarding email.
Click Next → Proceed → OK.
notes: You will see a popup asking you to verify forwarding.

sections.heading: Confirm forwarding
steps: In our app, go to Settings and scroll to 'Your activation link'.
Click the confirmation link to confirm the forwarding address.

sections.heading: Filter for only transaction-related emails
sections.description: Filters ensure that only transaction-related emails are forwarded.
steps: Go to the 'Filters and Blocked Addresses' tab.
Click 'Create a new filter'.
Customize the filter using sender and subject/body wrapped in double quotes.
notes: Filter rules vary by bank. Check your transaction emails for correct content.
DBS PayLah users must create a separate filter for 'paylah.alert@dbs.com'.
If your bank has a wallet feature, remember to create a separate filter.

sections.heading: Confirming filter
steps: Click 'Create Filter' and select 'Forward it to' your unique forwarding email.
Click the blue 'Create Filter' button.
Verify that the filter appears in the list.

testing.heading: Testing Filter (very very very important!)
testing.description: Expenses will not be tracked correctly if filters do not work as intended.
steps: In Gmail settings, go to Filters and Blocked Addresses.
Edit the newly created filter and click 'Search'.
Verify that only intended transaction emails are shown.
Repeat this for all filters.

warnings.heading: DO NOT FORWARD ALL EMAILS
points: Forwarding all emails can result in loss of privacy.
It can also overload our servers, causing dropped requests.
warnings.instruction: Select the 'Disable forwarding' option to prevent forwarding all emails.
